text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~♪ My heart is still racing!
choice_data_list: That was exactly the win I envisioned!

We can't let our guard down. Let's keep 
doing our best for the next one.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I think that was a pretty good run. ...Did 
I manage to sparkle?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I hope I'm at least a little closer 
to running like all the Tiara Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
If I keep doing my best like this, I'll 
leave... my very own hoofprints—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I want to etch it into everyone's 
memories!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
All the Tiara Umamusume never stopped 
showing such cool, inspiring runs...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I can't let myself be satisfied with just 
this either!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu~. I'm still so happy that I can't 
wipe this grin off my face~.
